description.en: Adjusts incident light level and threshold from target/background samples.
description.pt: Ajusta nível de luz e limiar usando amostras de alvo/fundo.

description.en: Response mode changes speed, light intensity and interference behavior; use the variant table.
description.pt: Modo de resposta altera velocidade, intensidade e interferência; consulte a tabela da variante.

description.en: Through-beam detection uses Dark ON; reflective detection uses Light ON for output active with a workpiece.
description.pt: Detecção por barreira usa Dark ON; reflexiva usa Light ON para saída ativa com alvo.

description.en: UP/DOWN adjusts the threshold; holding changes it faster.

description.en: After tuning, DPC compensates incident-light changes; recommended for through-beam/retroreflective use.
